title: Diamond strength and conditional side honors
author_notes: Reviewed during EC-033 implementation; see docs/COACHING_REVIEW.md. Independent hand; ratings are authored judgments, not probabilities or guaranteed outcomes.

feedback.title: A measured Diamond target
feedback.summary: Four Diamonds uses top trump control without counting every side honor as a winner.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Diamonds head a five-card trump suit.
Probable: Heart Ace can win a side trick; additional Diamonds may be promoted.
Risk: the Spade King is conditional, and side winners can be ruffed.

feedback.title: Length supports five
feedback.summary: Five Diamonds has support from three top trumps, length, and the Heart Ace. The Spade King remains conditional.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Diamonds head a five-card trump suit.
Probable: Heart Ace can win a side trick; additional Diamonds may be promoted.
Risk: the Spade King is conditional, and side winners can be ruffed.

feedback.title: Six needs the extras
feedback.summary: Six Diamonds relies more heavily on promoted trumps, useful ruffs, or the Spade King surviving.
points: Control: Ace-King-Queen of Diamonds head a five-card trump suit.
Probable: Heart Ace can win a side trick; additional Diamonds may be promoted.
Risk: the Spade King is conditional, and side winners can be ruffed.

feedback.title: Four Sans has controls
feedback.summary: Three top Diamonds and the Heart Ace give a credible foundation, though Clubs can surrender the lead.
points: Control: three top Diamonds and the Heart Ace are useful high cards.
Conditional: King-4 of Spades is not an automatic extra winner.
Risk: Clubs have no top control; opponents may cash winners while you lack the lead.

feedback.title: The King is not a fifth certainty
feedback.summary: Five Sans needs more than the clear top controls. The Spade King may lose to the Ace.
points: Control: three top Diamonds and the Heart Ace are useful high cards.

feedback.title: Too many conditional winners
feedback.summary: Six Sans assumes several extra winners without trump protection or a secure Club holding.
